items.summary: Following completion of the transaction, Double Eagle plans to continue development across its remaining assets in Reagan County.

items.title: Diamondback Energy (FANG) Makes A $5 Billion Midland Basin Bet
items.summary: Diamondback Energy (NasdaqGS:FANG) agreed to acquire Double Eagle’s Midland Basin assets for US$5b, expanding its Permian position. The deal brings a larger drilling inventory and additional Midland Basin acreage into Diamondback Energy’s portfolio. Management describes the acquisition as immediately accretive and a key step in reshaping Diamondback’s production and asset mix. This US$5b purchase of Double Eagle’s Midland Basin assets is a major move that investors may want to weigh against...
